Helpful information

Frequently asked questions.

What is the starting price for a bed?

The website lists a starting price of ₹17,000 for a 78 × 60 inch bed. The final price depends on the design and specifications. Please confirm the current price with us.

How do I get the price of a particular design?

Tap the WhatsApp link under the design you like. The message includes its name and catalogue number to help our team identify it.

Can I ask about a different size or finish?

Yes, send your required dimensions and preferred finish through WhatsApp. We will confirm what is available for the selected design.

Where is Kaaba Furniture located?

Kaaba Furniture, a unit of Kaaba Enterprises, is based at No. 4/1, Manalvariturai Road, Sangliyandapuram, Trichy 620001, Tamil Nadu, India.

How can I confirm delivery and payment details?

Please discuss the current delivery availability, charges, payment terms and expected timeline with our team and get the agreed details in writing before placing an order.

© 2026 Kaaba Enterprises. All rights reserved.Product images are for design reference. Confirm specifications and current prices before ordering.
Privacy Policy
  • When you message or call us, we receive your name, phone number, delivery address and the designs you ask about. This site has no forms, accounts or payment pages.
  • We use these details only to reply, quote, make and deliver your order, and to look after it afterwards.
  • We do not sell your details. We share them only with the transport or fitting staff who deliver your order.
  • WhatsApp chats are also covered by WhatsApp's own privacy policy.
  • To correct or delete your details, message us. We may keep billing records for as long as tax law requires.
Terms and Conditions
  • Kaaba Furniture is a unit of Kaaba Enterprises, Sangliyandapuram, Trichy, Tamil Nadu.
  • Photos are for design reference. Wood grain, colour and finish vary from piece to piece.
  • Starting prices are for the size stated. The final price depends on the design, size, wood and finish, and we confirm it on WhatsApp before you order.
  • Every piece is made to order. An order is confirmed once we agree the design, size, price and delivery time with you in writing (WhatsApp is fine) and receive any advance we have agreed.
  • Delivery times are estimates. Delays caused by transport, weather or other things outside our control do not make us liable. Please make sure the piece can be brought into your room.
  • Our liability is limited to the price you paid for the piece. These terms follow Indian law, and the courts at Tiruchirappalli have jurisdiction.
Return Policy
  • Each piece is handcrafted to your chosen design, size and finish, so we cannot accept returns or exchanges for a change of mind once an order is confirmed.
  • Please check the piece when it is delivered. If it is damaged or has a manufacturing defect, tell us on WhatsApp or by phone, with photos, within 2 days of delivery.
  • After checking, we will repair or replace the affected part.
  • Natural variation in grain and colour, wear from use, water damage, misuse and changes made by others are not defects.
  • If you cancel before we start making your piece, the advance is returned after deducting the cost of materials already bought. Approved refunds go back the way you paid.
  • To raise a damage or return request, call or WhatsApp 6374716574.
